----------------------
--CREATE CREDENTIAL 
 ----------------------  
 CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL samcreds
 WITH
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

------------------------------
--CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE
 ------------------------------     

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://synapsestoragesam.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = samcreds
)

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source_abfss
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'abfss://raw@synapsestoragesam.dfs.core.windows.net',
    CREDENTIAL = samcreds
)



-- CREATE PARQUET FILE FORMAT --
CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT parquet_format
WITH
(
   FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET,
   DATA_COMPRESSION = 'org.apache.hadoop.io.compress.SnappyCodec' 
)
